Class VariableNumber

java.lang.Object
jwat.VariableNumber
All Implemented Interfaces:
JWATConstants
Direct Known Subclasses:
VariableDate, VariableString
public class VariableNumber extends Object implements JWATConstants
Description: This class represents a single variable which contains numerical values. It provides statistics information and variable transofrmations and sampling operations
Author:
Brambilla Davide Matr 667986, Fumagalli Claudio 667971 Created: 1-ago-2006 Modified: 27-dec-2006
